title: Creative Control Is Not Economic Control
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: The power to approve a silhouette, campaign, or brand aesthetic is not automatically the power to appoint the board, control a vote, receive the economics, sell an asset, or survive termination.
One frame holds a named designer, a model, a photographer, a collection, and an institutional record—separate roles that public shorthand often compresses.
narrativeSequence.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

narrativeSequence.caption: 01 · CREATIVE — What can be approved?. Define the domain: collection, silhouette, casting, campaign, store environment, brand aesthetic, collaborator, or final release. “Creative control” without subject, threshold, and override mechanism is a slogan, not an operational record.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · GOVERNANCE — Who directs the company?. For a Delaware corporation, start with the certificate, bylaws, board composition, delegated authority, and §141. Then inspect committees, reserved matters, stockholder rights, and actual agreements rather than assuming the creative title controls the enterprise.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · ECONOMICS — Who receives value and bears risk?. Equity ownership, voting rights, salary, royalty, bonus, license income, liquidation preference, debt covenants, and sale proceeds are distinct economic or control mechanisms. Public proxy and annual-report disclosures can demonstrate some layers while leaving private arrangements unknown.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · FAILURE TEST — What happens after conflict or departure?. Map removal, termination, good-reason provisions, cure periods, post-term use, transition duties, archive access, approval survival, and dispute procedure. Authority that exists only while a title is held may disappear differently from voting power or asset ownership.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

mapping.prompt: Write every claimed creative power as a verb plus object: approve casting, reject a campaign, select a collaborator.
Attach the agreement, board delegation, policy, or practice record supporting each power.
Map voting, equity, compensation, sale, appointment, removal, and information rights separately.
Run departure, deadlock, incapacity, sale, and succession scenarios with qualified corporate and employment counsel.
